steps: Opened title, saw globe with pins
Tapped Take office as United States (Hormuz Convoy)
Skimmed mission briefing, tapped Take office
Picked a card, Execute month, read result, Next month
scenarios.notes: First choice made in about 40 seconds, result card with numbers moving in about 60 seconds.

steps: War with Iran ended after month 1 choice (escorts)
Never found a way to make peace myself beyond the cards offered; left 4 political capital unspent
scenarios.notes: The cards gave me big-feeling choices but I did not see an 'I stopped a war' moment I caused on purpose.

friction.happened: Wall of 7 goals with numbers (approval 44%, needs 56%, UAE relations 75, needs 66) before first action
IRGC, midterm clock, Muscat, Bandar Abbas, Qatari text: names and acronyms I do not know, no help on screen
'Hurts: Approval of 56%+ after the midterms' is long goal-speak; tags 'Gaza order', 'contributors', 'Mobilization' unclear
Counter and coin icons with no explanation; I did not know what to spend the coins on

friction.where: Month 3 card tap via text label
friction.happened: Driver text tap failed (harness); coordinate tap worked
Body paragraph cut with a small More link; fine, but crisis headings like 'Cabinet pick: Reply via Muscat' were opaque
4 coins banked, nothing told me what big move they buy

bugs.title: Gaza civil order falls and Egypt view falls but card is stamped STEP ACHIEVED
steps: Month 3 pick Let the region sort it out
bugs.actual: Stamp shown while Egypt's view dropped and a mission goal still off track

suggestions.what: Collapse the briefing to one sentence and 2 or 3 goals with icons; skip numbers until asked
Gloss unknown names inline in a few words (IRGC = Iran's navy and army)
Explain coins once on screen and offer one obvious big action (make peace) to spend them on

delight: Globe title with pins feels like a game (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/olivia-phone/001-title.png)
Your Pick stamp on the card (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/olivia-phone/006-pick2.png)
Month result card with bars moving and newspaper line (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/olivia-phone/009-e2.png)
The war with Iran is over after my first choice (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/olivia-phone/010-m3.png)
Best for your mission tag told me what to pick

fun.reason: Choice then visible result within a minute, nice art and stamps; the choices stayed abstract.

clarity.reason: Cards are clear; names, goal-speak and coins are not.

visual.reason: Painted scenes and globe look like a real game, not work software.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Stamps, results and tags feel game-like; briefing list does not.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but pre-selected cabinet picks and unspent coins made me feel steered.

realism.reason: I cannot judge; war ending in one month felt too easy.

replay.reason: Would try another place if a friend asked, not on my own.

recommend.reason: I would send it to a friend who likes politics, not to my nurse friends.

verbatim: Oh, the stamp is cute. But who is the IRGC and what is a Muscat? I just pick the one the game says is best.
